description: This file contains the implementation of an AVL tree node template class, including its constructors, destructors, rotation operations, insertion, deletion, search, cloning, parent setting, and sorting functionalities. It also includes operator overloads for memory management and specializations for particular types.

classes.name: AVLNode
classes.description: A template class representing a node in an AVL self-balancing binary search tree, supporting insertion, deletion, rotation, cloning, and search operations.

methods.name: void * operator new(size_t size)
methods.description: Overloads new operator to allocate memory using zmalloc.

methods.name: void operator delete(void * p)
methods.description: Overloads delete operator to free memory using zfree.

methods.name: AVLNode constructor
methods.description: Constructs a node with key and optional data.

methods.name: AVLNode<T1,T2> * Clone(AVLNode<T1,T2> * node)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the subtree rooted at this node.

methods.name: void SetParent(AVLNode<T1,T2> * node,AVLNode<T1,T2> * parent)
methods.description: Recursively sets parent pointers for the subtree.

methods.name: int RotateOnce(AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root,dir_t dir)
methods.description: Performs a single rotation in the AVL tree to restore balance.

methods.name: int RotateTwice(AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root,dir_t dir)
methods.description: Performs a double rotation in the AVL tree to restore balance.

methods.name: int ReBalance(AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root)
methods.description: Rebalances the subtree rooted at this node if needed.

methods.name: bool Insert(T1 key,AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root,int & heightChange,AVLNode<T1,T2> * & node)
methods.description: Inserts a new node or data into the AVL tree, maintaining balance.

methods.name: bool Delete(T1 key,AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root,int & heightChange,T1 & removedNode,avl_find_mode_t mode)
methods.description: Removes a node with the specified key from the AVL tree.

methods.name: AVLNode<T1,T2> * Find(dir_t dir)
methods.description: Searches for a node with the specified key.

methods.name: bool Sort(bool asc,T1 * sortedArray,int & index) const
methods.description: Performs an in-order traversal to sort the tree into an array.

methods.name: AVLNode(AVLNode<T1,T2> * left,AVLNode<T1,T2> * right,T1 k,T2 & v,AVLNode<T1,T2> * parent,int b,int c)
bool Find(T1 key,const AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root) const
bool Find(dir_t dir,const AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root) const
bool Insert(T1 key,T2 & data,AVLNode<T1,T2> * & root,int & heightChange,AVLNode<T1,T2> * & node)
